hash.description: Root or chunk hash as sha256:<64 hex>. Provide exactly one of hash or tool_use_id.

tool_use_id.description: tool_use_id taken from a tombstone or a recall hit.

full.description: Return the whole object instead of the minimum sufficient span.

span.description: Explicit span: "<off>:<len>" in bytes, or "L<start>-L<end>" in lines.
